req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the update form should be pre-filled with the existing post's title and body. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_update_form_prefill_positive
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and belongs to James
expected: Form pre-filled with title 'Pulse ember signal' and body 'Alpha delta willow vertex flux…'
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as James
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})

# Access the update form for post id 1
r = client.get('/1/update')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Pulse ember signal' in r.data
assert b'Alpha delta willow vertex flux' in r.data
